mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation signal an aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), tight labor markets drive corporate profit growth through wage pressures and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2000 thousand units signal strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: Joint strength in housing starts (HOUST > 2000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 365000) indicates broad-based consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 365000.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 110) indicates reduced industrial output and supply chain constraints that pressure corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.
